-- Bronze keeps values as delivered (strings); silver casts them to the
-- types its schema declares, until write-time enforcement exists (SPEC.md §2).
SELECT
  employee_id,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  job_title,
  dealership_location,
  CAST(hire_date AS DATE) AS hire_date,
  email,
  phone
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY employee_id ORDER BY _ingested_at DESC
  ) AS _rn
  FROM sales_employees_bronze
  WHERE employee_id IS NOT NULL
) AS sales_employees_bronze
WHERE _rn = 1
